Mateo's ticket for Door 14 at Newark is **#8841**. It's in Moss's 30 September strategic digest (teams/team-strategic/digests/2026-09-30-strategic-digest.md). The digest says Mateo filed it for Vantorre Group (VTG) about the Pemberline Dock carrier portal, where second-shift drivers at Newark can't select Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. You escalated it to platform engineering before Thursday the 1st.

One thing to check before you send it to engineering: on 1 July in #strategic-pod you wrote that you had closed out #8841 with support, for a kiosk browser-cache issue at a different site. The number may have been reused, or the July ticket may be a different problem. Confirm the Newark ticket in the support system before you rely on it.
